sentences.text:
Nzubechi Promise vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April,
2025
Author: Dinesh Kumar Paliwal

Bench: Dinesh Kumar Paliwal
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:17260
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Dinesh Kumar Paliwal
 On The 9 th Of April, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 32641 of 2024
 Nzubechi Promise
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Aman Soni - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Pradeep Gupta - Government Advocate for the responden

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of the Cr.P.C., 1973) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.171/2021 registered at Police Station-Cyber Cell, District- Bhopal (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 201, 204, 465, 466, 467, 468, 471, 419, 420 of IPC, Section 14 of Foreigners Act and Sections 66-C & 66-D of Information Technology Act.

Applicant is in detention since 15.03.2022.
2.
Applicant's first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 27.02.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.3646 of 2024 by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

The Bench which had decided the earlier bail application of the applicant is not hearing the bail application on account of change in Roster, therefore, in the light of law laid down by Hon'ble the Apex Court in the case of Shekhar Prasad Mahto @ Shekhar Kushwaha Vs. NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17260 2 MCRC-32641-2024 The Registrar General, Jharkhand High Court & Anr.

entities.text: Shekhar Prasad Mahto @ Shekhar Kushwaha Vs. NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17260 2 MCRC-32641-2024
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
{Writ Petition (S)
(Criminal) No.55/2025 dated 07.02.2025}, this bail application has been placed before this Court.

3 Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is in detention since 15.03.2022 i.e.
more than a period of three years.
He has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.

It is submitted that complainant has already been examined before the Trial Nzubechi Promise vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31240534/
1 Court.

entities.text: Trial Nzubechi Promise vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions as imposed by the Court.
On the aforesaid pretext, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail, pending the trial.
4 On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Applicant's first bail application has already been dismissed on merit and there is no change in the circumstances to form a different opinion than the view taken earlier by co-ordinate Bench of this Court, therefore, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the applicant.

Consequently, this second application too under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 (Section 439 of CrPC,
1973) for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant - Nzubechi Promise stands dismissed .

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Nzubechi Promise vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31240534/
